verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents key-based SSH access to instances, with password authentication disabled (vast-ai-docs-9, vast-ai-docs-43). Users can manage their own SSH keys through the tooling (vast-ai-docs-4) and connect via the CLI workflow (vast-ai-docs-34). Docker run options with custom ports suggest control over the container environment (vast-ai-docs-52). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of root-level access inside instances, step-by-step docs on adding user-supplied public keys, and independent hands-on corroboration of SSH and root use.
